notes: Room twists (S1 #4). A Tower battle or challenge room after the first one may get one twist, never more. 'chance' is per eligible room, tuned so about 1 room in 4 of a whole run has a twist. 'banner' and 'sensei' lines are PLACEHOLDERS: they need the Content Writer's approval. No twist may hide a warning.

twists.name: Lantern Dark
twists.banner: Lantern Dark: the room is dim, but red circles glow bright!
twists.sensei: It's dark in here. Look for the glowing circles!

twists.name: Slippery Floor
twists.banner: Slippery Floor: your Dash slides farther!
twists.sensei: Whee! The floor is slippery. Your Dash goes far!

twists.name: Bell Room
twists.banner: Bell Room: ring 3 bells for a bonus prize!
twists.sensei: Each Perfect Counter rings a bell. Can you ring three?
